text:
Rae: Morning micro-poll: Is it true the office plant has a name?
Jon: yes, it's 'Sir Photosynthesis' (bless him)
Tess: Sir Photosynthesis is thriving after Rae's mysterious weekend watering. Who's the gardener hero? :herb:
Rae: guilty. I whispered encouragements to him.
Nora: can we start a plant adoption roster? My cactus needs friends.
Jon: vote: name baby fern 'Fernie Sanders' or 'Leaf Erickson'? React :one: for Fernie, :two: for Leaf.
Tess: Fernie Sanders forever. Also, we should make a tiny scarf for Sir Photosynthesis for winter.
Botty: reminder: shared plants are community responsibility. If you water, note it in #kitchen-hub.
Rae: archival note: new tradition proposal - 'Plant Friday' where one person gives a 30s pep talk to the plants.
Nora: I'm in. I'll bring motivational playlist (soft ambient).
Jon: lore update: Sir Photosynthesis survived 'The Great Desk Move' of 2025. He is a legend.
Tess: also, trending: someone left a tiny googly eye on the ficus. It is now an honorary mascot.
Rae: paperwork for mascot status is optional but recommended.
Nora: practical: who has a spare small pot? Mine cracked during the move.
Jon: I have one. Will leave on top of the fridge with a note 'For Plant Emergencies.'
Tess: closing poll: scarf yes/no. React :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.
Rae: thanks team. Tiny traditions are the best traditions.
Botty: planned reminder: "Plant Friday" recurring event created for next Friday 11:30.
Jon: I'll craft Fernie Sanders' first speech. Agenda: sunlight appreciation and nitrogen jokes.
Nora: love it. We've entered the Saga of Sir Photosynthesis.
Tess: Photo-op scheduled. Please bring celebratory soil.
Rae: end of thread: Long live Sir Photosynthesis. :seedling:
